name: Pangle · Gremlet #44
description:
A baby pangolin covered in pinecone scales. Rolls into a ball when it's shy.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Pangle in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
